title: 菊花賞の後に・恥じて叱って、進め

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although Mejiro McQueen puts up a strong fight for first, she loses her match with Mejiro Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, she can't simply hang her head in shame. She bounces back from defeat, declaring that she'll train harder and become even stronger.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ryan expresses her gratitude for their sincere match. But there is still more to come, and she doesn't intend to lose.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And so… Mejiro McQueen sets her sights on her next objective: the spring Tenno Sho. She is eager to show the culmination of all her hard work.
